rounds.summary: Round 1 rendered three directions: A Swatch Shelf (japanese-minimal), B Label Ledger (editorial-serif), C Spectrum (live-tile), in app/renders/r1/a, b, c. The critic picked c+b: C's spectrum shelf with B's scent-strip detail. I agree: C's spectrum is the only signature that argues the thesis alone and the owner favours loud, structural ideas; B's blotter strip gives the detail screen the same chord.
changes: Three directions written in direction.md section 5 and rendered, with HTML mocks for the shelf of each.
Chosen merge c+b recorded; the style scent-box-chord is built from it in round 2.

variants.change: direction A Swatch Shelf (swatch tiles on paper)
direction B Label Ledger (ruled catalogue, scent strip detail)
direction C Spectrum (37 strips on dark)

rounds.summary: Round 2 builds the c+b style scent-box-chord and answers the round 1 review (fixes f1 to f9). App renders are in app/renders/r2/: Shelf, Fragrance and Add fragrance Mac windows plus the kit, light and dark, and three HTML mocks (shelf, fragrance, add-fragrance) built from app/draft-pack.md tokens.
changes: Kit restyled to the spectrum direction: buttons, tabs, segmented controls and fields are bare text with underlines, cards, panels and list rows are the ground, radius is 0, the selected list row is a 3px ink bar, the topbar is the canvas, and the primary arrow is blanked (f1).
Shelf mock draws all 37 strips in accord colours with a house monogram under each group and the d'Annam sampler kept as one group (f3).
Fragrance mock draws notes as three stacked colour bands beside a tall scent strip, and accords as one labelled weighted bar instead of 'aromatic 100' rows (f4, f7).
Labels and buttons in the mocks are sentence case with no tracked capitals and no boxed badges (f5).
The shelf numeral is 84px, about half the first mock, with the spectrum as the first read; Add fragrance is a bold word at the toolbar's trailing edge, not a slab (f6).
The format split (7 bottles, 3 small, 24 samples) is a bar along the foot of the shelf and the spectrum fills the window, so the screen ends deliberately (f9).
Add fragrance mock shows the chord in accord colours as the accords field is typed (f8).
Product sheet drops the 'aromatic 100' accord rows for a plain legend line.

variants.change: material: grey tiles, outlined and filled buttons to bare text with underlines and no containers
primary action: heavy-underline material tried, killed because its label colour assumes a fill and fails contrast on 8 stress palettes; quiet-text bold kept
preview primary: cream #f2efe8 tried, killed because the sheet tile strip vanished in light mode; mid warm grey #8a847a kept

notes.text: f1 (P1): restyle the kit to match the mock with no grey tiles, black selected rows or slab buttons.
f2 (P2): chord strips in the sheet renders are a one-colour ramp; the sheet's tiles block cannot take accord colours, so only the mocks show them.
f3 (P2): label the strips by house.
f4 (P2): notes as three stacked bands, accords as a weighted bar.
f5 (P2): remove tracked caps. Done in the mocks; the renderer still sets sheet labels and the primary button in uppercase and the style cannot override it.
f6 (P2): shrink the shelf numeral and move Add away from the slab.
f7 (P2): replace 'aromatic 100' rows with the coloured weighted chord bar.
f8 (P3): chord preview as the accords field is typed.
f9 (P3): fill the empty lower area of the shelf.
The kit cannot draw the primary as a heavy-underlined word (label colour fails contrast); it is bold plain text in the kit and in the mocks.

rounds.summary: Round 3 answers the round 2 review (fixes f1 to f10). It adds the generic code-tier moves label-case and press-fade in js/moves/bare-type.js, removes the accord tiles and pills from the sheet, pins the primary action, and fixes the mocks. App renders are in app/renders/r3/ (Shelf, Fragrance, Add fragrance, kit; light and dark; plus the three mocks).
changes: f1: new move label-case sets case and tracking of labels, tabs, buttons and the top-bar title; the style uses none and 0, so no tracked capitals remain. The 'out of 10' and '7 bottles' pills are gone: the numerals no longer take a meta chip and the counts are a plain muted line.
f2: the accord tiles are removed from the sheet; accords are shown as words, and direction.md section 8 lists the chord, notes bands and live preview as mock-only. Nothing is faked.

f3: new state press-fade presses every button by fading it to 70% with no fill; kit pressed specimens lose the grey slab. The kit page's own cell frames are drawn by the kit page, not the style, and remain.
f4: Add fragrance, Save and Save fragrance are pinned to the bottom bar at full ink, above the fold.
f5: the shelf sheet drops list rows with chevrons and the Filter row for plain text lines grouped by house, so the numeral and tabs are the first read; Add is one bold word in the bottom bar.
f6: accord label ink in the mocks is chosen per segment by contrast against near-black or white.
f7: the shelf mock names every house in full, staggered on up to four rows under its group, instead of monograms.
f8: notes are plain text lines without chevrons in the sheet render; the mock keeps the three colour bands.
f9: the add mock keeps one chord (the tall strip, labelled inside) and drops the duplicate bar.
f10: the shelf mock names the d'Annam sampler group and ends on the format bar.

sheet list rows with chevrons to plain text lines grouped by house

The kit page's own specimen cell frames are not controllable from a style (no catalog move turns kit-cell-frame off).

rounds.summary: Round 4 answers the round 3 review (f1 to f6). It adds the generic move bare-edge to js/moves/bare-type.js and tightens the mocks. App renders are in app/renders/r4/.
changes: f1: the shelf mock labels each house on one row, 6px right of its tick, and drops the label for a group too narrow to hold it; no tick crosses a label.

f2: the pinned Add fragrance and Save sat 16px inside the text edge because the stock button caption keeps 16px side padding, which the style controls. New move bare-edge sets button padding to 0, so they align to the text edge. The window dots sat on the left edge because the style's topbar rule left no side padding; bare-edge now sets the title bar side padding to 20px.
f3: the shelf numeral is 56px (was 84px) and the focused name 76px, so the name is the first read after the spectrum.
f4: the add mock now shows how the fragrance will read on the shelf (house and name set large) beside the chord strip.
f5: the three grey window squares are removed from every mock; the toolbar starts on the 40px edge.
f6: the fragrance mock fills the lower left with the format split showing this bottle's share of the shelf.

rounds.summary: Round 8 reconciles r6 f1 and r7 f1. The r7 change applied 'fill the full height' too literally and opened voids inside the fragrance columns; this round composes each screen as one block. App renders are in app/renders/r8/.
changes: Fragrance mock: columns end where their content ends. The middle column runs house, name, facts, description, rating, then the format bar directly under it. The right column runs notes tiers, accords bar, then My notes directly under it. The scent strip spans exactly the content block (top of the house line to the bottom of the taller column). The block is centred vertically in the window, and the note swatches are 72px (was 58px) so the block fills more of it.
Add mock: the chord strip ends exactly on the Accords underline, and the whole form block is centred vertically, so there is no empty bottom fifth.
This supersedes the r6 f1 and r7 f1 instruction to push items to the window foot (SKILL.md Phase 5 step 5: when a fix has more than one answer, try variants and keep one).
